plain: Not working; failing to get the result wanted

webster.text: Not producing its proper effect, or not able to produce its effect; inefficient; weak; as an ineffectual remedy; the Spaniards made an ineffectual attempt to reduce Gibraltar.

example.quote: The causes which, with other nations, rendered leagues ineffectual and inadequate to the security and happiness of the people, do not exist here.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 10, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
